title: Don’t Go To Extremes: Revealing the Excessive Sensitivity and Calibration Limitations of LLMs in Implicit Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing classification performance (precision vs. recall) on implicit hate speech datasets (Latent Hatred, SBIC, ToxiGen) to measure model over-sensitivity, specifically identifying high false-positive rates when benign statements contain terms related to sensitive demographic groups (e.g., 'black women', 'Muslims').
